name: Saltaire
countries: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: Saltaire is a Victorian model village near Bradford in West Yorkshire, built between 1851 and 1871 by mill owner Titus Salt. He wanted his textile workers to live in better homes than the city's slums. Neat stone terraces and grand public buildings still surround the huge Salts Mill, now home to an art gallery, restaurants and shops.
